title: Why Rain Is Not a Reason to Cancel
author: Wren Alder
summary: Most of the photos people love were made on days they nearly stayed home.
content:
I get the same message every autumn: the forecast looks bad, shall we move it? Sometimes yes. Often no.

Thin cloud is the biggest softbox in the world. It evens out skin, deepens every green and gets rid of the squint. Light rain keeps the crowds away, too, so you'll have the trail to yourselves.

The only weather I really cancel for is high wind in the trees and lightning on a ridge. Everything else is just a good reason to bring a better coat.
